paper.title_en: Development of PMT/WLS optical modules for Cherenkov detectors
paper.abstract_en: Cherenkov detectors are widely used instruments in high-energy physics to detect and identify charged particles by measuring Cherenkov radiation. The largest water Cherenkov detector, Hyper-Kamiokande, has an incredible active volume of 258 kton of ultrapure water. The veto system for Hyper-Kamiokande will have the limited number of optical readout channels, 3600 3-inch PMTs, to view the whole veto volume that requires concentration of Cherenkov light on PMTs. Wavelength shifting plates were chosen as the method to increase in 2 times the light collection on PMTs. This work presents the development of optical modules based on a PMTs connected with a wavelength-shifting plate. The modules are engineered to maximize Cherenkov photon capture and collection of re-emitted light on PMT. Production and machining of WLS plates, various testing methods for plate's light yield, comparative performance of WLS plates with different dopants and their concentrations, studies of the dark rate and aging are presented in this paper.
